domains.name: Concord
domains.purpose: Product-wide Concord law and architecture: cross-cutting constitutional constraints, development authority, and decisions that bind every child Domain rather than any single one.

domains.name: Durable authority
domains.purpose: Owns the durable state envelope: the SQLite authority, the append-only event log, typed projections, migrations, fold guards, and the transactional guarantees that make an acknowledged write durable.

domains.name: Workflow engine
domains.purpose: Owns work lifecycle: workflow types and their contracts, workflow actions and transitions, completion predicates and verdicts, evidence binding, architecture overlap resolution, and terminal-state law.

domains.name: Agent surface
domains.purpose: Owns the typed agent plane: the read and mutation tool surface, its budget and evolution constraints, call context, lanes and worker dispatch, the adapter transport contract, and the agent result envelope.

domains.name: Product memory and law
domains.purpose: Owns Product knowledge: the knowledge index and its records, the Domain registry as law, law-coverage and conformance records, lessons and research, and compaction and retention policy.

domains.name: Work coordination
domains.purpose: Owns the work item as an entity: its declared attributes and urgency, provenance, the typed relation vocabulary between work items, durable inter-agent resource claims, work-addressed peer messages, and non-authoritative mid-execution observations. It owns what a work item means and how work items refer to one another, not how work executes and not how it persists.

domains.name: Operator surface
domains.purpose: Owns the human-facing plane: the terminal launcher, the CLI verb surface and its operator diagnostics, installation and release packaging, and the navigation path an operator uses to reach Product state.

domains.name: Repository verification
domains.purpose: Owns the authority a repository check may hold: what a validator may assert, what it may block, how required checks bind to declared coverage, and the boundary between a check's finding and accepted Product law.

records.product_wide_rationale: Mandates that six predecessor capabilities be carried forward and binds the method for deciding their shapes. The mandate spans product-memory, work-coordination, and durable-authority at once, and its D4 authorizes no implementation in any of them.
records.summary: Six predecessor strengths (specs, narrative artifacts, knowledge index, conformance, triage, reflection) are preservation-mandated, each research-informed in its Concord shape rather than inherited.
records.title: Predecessor-strength preservation and research-informed redesign

records.summary: Retains the Git-authoritative, SQLite-derived knowledge-index shape, bounded Q9/Q10 query boundary, independent code intelligence, and separate conformance repair path.
records.title: Retain the manifest-primary knowledge-index shape

records.summary: Floor condition 1 is claimable without an operator authoring surface: planning happens through an agent session, and full Product scope means every Product is reachable from the launcher rather than a result set spanning Products.
records.title: Floor condition 1 means reach, not an operator authoring surface

records.summary: Active research findings reuse durable knowledge’s home-or-explicit Product, Project, Domain, and tag scope vocabulary while remaining disposable active context with no writer or tool surface.
records.title: Active research findings carry applies-to scope

records.summary: Recorded verdicts become readable, read-scoped results: every session except the recorded executing actor audits an acceptance; influence stays with CD-0013 D5.
records.title: Verdict read scope for the executing actor

records.summary: Historical record of the Epic reachability change and one-time TS9 exception; CD-0042 closes its pre-go-live version and model-trial policy without creating a current compatibility path.
records.title: Epic agent surface and narrow TS9 exception

records.summary: Research authoring reaches the agent tool surface under a research capability; workflow actions declare bindings the engine proves fail-closed against stale required revisions.
records.title: Research surface and engine-bound reliance

records.summary: Lessons publish through the archive surface into git and the manifest under operator approval; promotion is explicit scope; reflections are tagged lessons; evidence paths give law a structural drift audit.
records.title: Learning capture: lesson authoring, reflection, and drift audit

records.summary: CD-0016's re-derived pinned continuity already prevents silent authority loss across boundaries; restart-into-lane would only preserve in-flight working memory, which the host's session management owns.
records.title: Typed restart after a boundary is deliberately excluded

records.summary: Claims are durable records of intent on typed resource keys: work-item holders survive session death, contention refuses with coordination, terminal transition releases, and no authority is granted.
records.title: Durable resource claims for concurrent agents

records.summary: Messages are durable events addressed to work items: direct or Product-broadcast, pull-at-next-call delivery with a continuity pending pointer, withdrawable-with-visibility, structurally authority-free.
records.title: Peer messages addressed to durable work

records.summary: Observations are the durable form of noticing: a lightweight mid-life record on work items, visible at resume, carrying no authority; promotion to work stays the unchanged capture+raised_from path.
records.title: Mid-execution observations

records.summary: Launcher-started operator sessions receive one generated, digest-bound packet rendered from canonical continuity before OpenCode starts; the launcher remains identity-only.
records.title: Core-derived operator session boot

records.summary: Direction of labor is legitimate and out-of-band; changing a declared end-state binds through the single operator-approved supersession path, with clause 5 as the visible check and the unverifiable trigger documented.
records.title: Out-of-band operator direction binds through contract supersession

records.summary: Host injection is permitted only when recorded: dispatch evidence v3 carries a provenance digest over enumerable prompt surfaces, unenumerable ones are named, and D7 evals are reproducible only when lane and provenance digests both match.
records.title: Host prompt provenance is declared at dispatch

records.summary: Governing requirements bind to a Project rather than to a rule, and capture refuses by set difference against the requirements its target scope declares: invariant_violation naming the omitted requirements, typed operator options, no events, and a minted challenge the approved scope cut resolves against.
records.title: Governing requirements are scope-bound and refused at capture

records.summary: Law revision identity is the law ID and content hash; same-ID amendments remain compatible, while an accepted superseding law strictly quiesces old workflow consumers until recovery.
records.title: Breaking law supersession strictly quiesces old consumers

records.summary: Core-issued approval challenges carry a typed summary derived only from the exact operation, consequence, digest, scope, versions, and expiry the approval binds.
records.title: Approval consequence summaries are derived from validated facts

records.summary: Every operation declares a seconds ceiling; unsupported requests refuse before effects and accepted budgets become one propagated deadline.
records.title: Operation time budgets are explicit, per-operation, and never clamped

records.summary: Native-run status is a typed report attributed to the authenticated trusted client; failed health plus rollback records durable state and returns a workflow-action partial.
records.title: Native-run outcomes are attributed reports, not Concord findings

records.product_wide_rationale: Defines shared provenance and verification across Git state, worktrees, native runs, and recovery artifacts. Its own D1 states that provenance is shared while domain truth stays local, so the shared half has no single child owner.
records.summary: External observations share typed provenance and append-only verification; presence is broad, while absence and consequential use require pinned completeness and current proof.
records.title: External observations prove presence; absence requires pinned completeness

records.product_wide_rationale: Defines the Domain model itself, including what a Domain is and how law homes to one. A record that creates the partition cannot be owned by a Domain inside it.
records.summary: Makes Product law and architectural concordance Priority 1; canonical Domains own law and bind Product-changing work; concurrent Domain overlap requires version-pinned resolution; Initiative remains secondary context; SQLite remains sole local authority. CD-0042 amends only the pre-go-live agent-surface sequencing.
records.title: Architecture-bound Product law is Concord's primary coordination model

records.summary: Binds the current generated agent surface to one manifest digest, requires deterministic authority evidence, and removes unreleased compatibility, deprecation, model-trial gate, and replay machinery before go-live.
records.title: Pre-go-live development keeps one agent-surface path

records.summary: Concord owns the lane contract, evidence boundary, and provenance record but never lane methodology; methodology reaches a dispatch only through the CD-0034 enumerable host instruction surface, skills/ stays reserved with a closed reason, and the deferring coverage rows name the host owner.
records.title: Lane methodology is host-owned and provenance-recorded

records.summary: Worker-evidence CLI writes carry a signed worker-evidence-v1 assertion bound to the exact attempt, lane, readback, and provenance identity; the nonce is consumed in the appending transaction, worker_evidence is client-policy authority no grant can carry, terminal attempts refuse further evidence, and the recorded actor is a verified client.
records.title: Worker evidence writes authenticate their caller

records.summary: The Priority 2 concurrency invariant states bounded writer admission rather than zero contention; writer-admission wait, commit duration, and escaped busy failure are distinct measured quantities, correctness precedes latency, population identity is part of the bound, and CD-0011 retains sole ownership of the reopen conditions.
records.title: Concurrency law states bounded writer admission, not zero waiting

records.summary: An accepted conformance falsifier verdict is reachable only from the acceptance entry point run with the required-check signal the workflow sets; every other invocation stays inconclusive regardless of the threshold, a CI run missing the signal fails visibly, and CD-0011 structural wording is amended to the narrower enforceable claim of invocation provenance.
records.title: Conformance population authority is invocation provenance, not measured host isolation

records.summary: Every indexed law record carries a coverage state and a satisfied record cites typed anchors that resolve and execute in a required check; product reachability is computed by a pinned callgraph analysis and only its exceptions are declared; both planes reuse the floor-readiness state vocabulary and fail on an undeclared gap in either direction.
records.title: Coverage is declared, and an undeclared gap is a failure

records.summary: S2 renders as a panel stack in the terminal-launcher contract's job order — governing Domain with overlap state, blocked and blockers, next work; collapsed panels carry store-materialized answers and their reasons; ordering stays on the stored rank and deterministic store tiers, the closed screen set and widget floor are unchanged, and the Tab key becomes panel-focus cycling.
records.title: S2 composes the answers the store already materialized

records.summary: Concord-owned lane definitions reach a host only through a project's .opencode/agents/, because a global agent cannot be scoped and an environment-supplied definition presents no file for CD-0034 provenance to hash; Concord asserts required agent identity before launch rather than relying on --agent, whose unknown-name failure mode is a silent substitution with a success exit code; the orchestrator is constrained and verified rather than authored, since CD-0016 excludes an agent_definitions table; a session with absent required identity refuses to start. A trusted client policy names the agents it may present, and authorization refuses any other; the scope is fail-closed, so a client naming no agent authorizes none and must be re-registered.
records.title: Agent definitions are delivered per project, and Concord asserts agent identity itself

records.summary: Acknowledged consequential operations are durable across power loss via a TRUNCATE-checkpoint barrier that syncs the whole WAL even under synchronous=NORMAL; ordinary writes stay NORMAL and are durable through the last boundary; the barrier lives at the acknowledgement layer, not inside fence primitives.
records.title: Durable acknowledgement at consequential boundaries

records.summary: The sustained conformance falsifier weighs commit-duration P99, the quantity CD-0045 names as Concord-owned, against the unchanged 100ms target; wall and writer-admission wait stay measured and diagnostic, correctness precedence and population authority are untouched, and scheduler-owned overshoot on a shared runner reports as inconclusive instead of a law-grade fired verdict.
records.title: The conformance falsifier weighs commit duration, not scheduler time

records.summary: The work-relation kind implements is a directional, non-blocking, non-hierarchical, cycle-exempt many-to-one fulfilment link recording that a work item fulfils a decision-kind item; it is display-only until a consumer defines its read surface in a citing record, and removal stays off the table while it remains in the closed vocabulary.
records.title: implements declares fulfilment-link semantics, display-only

records.product_wide_rationale: Answers the three predecessor strengths CD-0019 D3 left open, distributing the outcomes across workflow-engine, agent-surface, and product-memory. It closes a Product-wide mandate rather than governing any single Domain.
records.summary: CD-0019 D3 closes: the gated human-checkpoint lifecycle is absorbed into typed approval routes and core-derived consequence summaries; the agreement-gate discipline is preserved as the CD-0012 outcome contract enforced at completion; standalone wisdom capture is preserved as CD-0026 lesson publication into the git knowledge home. CD-0082 amends the cutover framing without changing these answers.
records.title: The three un-mandated predecessor strengths are answered

records.summary: The routing policy loads from CONCORD_ROUTING_POLICY host state with the repo record as default template, failing closed when host state is set but unreadable; the lane registry becomes model-neutral, load-time validation replaces cross-file pinning including adapter-side opencode models existence checks, and the per-attempt digest-bound evidence boundary is unchanged.
records.title: Routing-policy authority is load-time host state

records.summary: Repository checks name one authority class — structural, real-tool, textual-guard, or warn-only. Invariants owned by types, tests, or generated digests are not restated by scanners; genuine static analysis wraps a pinned real tool and declares only exceptions; hand-written textual guards are legal only for invisible-failure classes with documented false-positive shape and a named retirement end-state; heuristic verdicts never block. check-store-boundary.py is replaced under the real-tool rule and check-tx-scope.py is deleted at its named structural end-state.
records.title: Repository checks are structural first, and textual guards are declared exceptions

records.summary: A lane report discharges its lane's declared evidence obligations: report evidence entries become typed obligation and detail pairs over one closed vocabulary shared by the lane and report contracts, the discharged evidence joins the worker.completed payload at version 2 with an explicit reported or legacy_unavailable origin, and a completion leaving any declared obligation undischarged is refused in the fold and recorded as a typed invalid_report failure instead.
records.title: A lane report discharges its lane's evidence obligations

records.summary: The accepted commit-duration falsifier verdict requires a clean unpaced control: a majority of paced production-like rounds exceeding the unchanged 100ms P99 target still sets threshold_status=exceeded, but a fired verdict additionally requires the in-run unpaced acceptance round to exceed the same target, so a paced overshoot with a clean control resolves to falsifier_status=inconclusive with the reason host scheduling. Correctness precedence, population authority, and CD-0051 D2's diagnostic wall and begin-wait measurements are unchanged.
records.title: The commit-duration falsifier requires a clean unpaced control

records.summary: Concord performs no model resolution: the adapter omits --model from lane dispatch and OpenCode resolves the executing model from host configuration; readback_model is the sole model evidence feeding CD-0017 D6 distinctness; the routing-policy record, the CONCORD_ROUTING_POLICY host state, the load-time validation, and the five declared-side worker-attempt columns (routing_policy_version, routing_policy_digest, resolved_model, resolution_role, fallback_reason) are retired under a schema migration; CD-0017 D2's dispatch flag is dropped and D8/D9 retire.
records.title: Concord performs no model routing

records.summary: Lane dispatch is a registered workflow action (dispatch_worker) reached through concord_work_transition.workflow_action; its D1 policy triple matches start_execution (external_effect, approval none, fenced, generic); the per-action capability is structural — the runtime reads the action's required_capability rather than hard-coding work_transition; the dispatch_worker action requires a new worker_dispatch capability that is registrable in a client policy but structurally non-grantable, mirroring worker_evidence; the worker-dispatch evidence boundary refuses when no authorized, unconsumed dispatch window exists for (work_id, step_id, attempt_epoch), closing the integrity hole a Task-tool spawn used to leave open; the adapter authorizes before spawning.
records.title: Lane dispatch is a registered workflow action

records.summary: Concord's Domain registry enacts seven child Domains under the Product root: durable-authority, workflow-engine, agent-surface, product-memory, work-coordination, operator-surface, and repository-verification. Every current law record declares one home_domain_id; eight Product-wide records stay at the root and 21 straddling records declare bounded applies_to_domain_ids. No Domain enters the registry owning no law, which defers predecessor-migration until its first law exists. Architecture relations carry governing_law_ids, and Domain identity is never inferred from a record's title.
records.title: The Domain registry enacts seven child Domains

records.summary: CD-0027 excludes lane restart only; orchestrator identity is recorded as a subject_type='session' domain event rather than a restart context boundary, the orphaned typed_agent_* columns and the restart boundary_kind are removed, and the orchestrator ruleset digest covers the resolved host artifacts the way CD-0034 host prompt provenance does.
records.title: Orchestrator identity is recorded as a session assertion, not a restart boundary

records.summary: A law record homed to the Product root declares product_wide_rationale: a stated, bounded reason why no child Domain owns it. Child-homed law must not carry the field. The CD-0041 D9.2 upcast writes an explicit undecided marker instead of inventing a claim, and check-domain-registry.py refuses any record still carrying it. law_domain_homes gains the column under migration 45 so the claim survives the PM1.Q10 projection proof. Manifest version 1.2 tightens in place because CD-0042 D1 keeps Concord pre-go-live with no compatibility cohort.
records.title: A root Domain home states why no child Domain owns it

records.summary: Concord installs its agent definitions, skills, and an authored tool-agnostic conduct corpus once under the versioned data root, and a consuming project holds a pointer rather than a copy. The always-on instruction surface is registered per project so non-Concord projects receive nothing, while agents live in the central OpenCode agents directory because no per-project pointer exists and an agent is inert until invoked. skills/ stays reserved so CD-0043 D3 is preserved, methodology stays host-owned under CD-0043 D1, and a loaded corpus file binds by content hash in the CD-0034 provenance manifest.
records.title: Concord ships an always-on operator conduct corpus

records.summary: Lane agents generate with mode: all so opencode run resolves the agent the adapter names instead of silently falling back to the default agent, and the sanitized export readback returns the executing agent beside the executing model. The adapter asserts the readback agent equals the dispatched concord-<lane> identity before any evidence is recorded: a mismatch is a typed agent_identity_mismatch failure that records no worker evidence and can never drive worker-complete. CD-0058 D2 is clarified as model-scoped; its D1 and the lane registry digests are untouched.
records.title: Run-mode lane dispatch asserts its executor

records.summary: The 48-scenario conformance corpus pins the shipped definition version and exercises the per-work-kind Product-truth classification the shipped definitions declare. Product-changing scenarios author their Domain home, architecture binding, overlap resolution, notice severity, and audit supersession explicitly; overlap blocking gains its first conformance coverage; no definition exists solely to give the corpus a non-Product-changing target; numbering 1..48 is preserved. Law revisions carry synthetic IDs, and the WF48 acceptance-step expectation stands with the version-keyed gate that suppressed strict checks removed under #400 rather than accommodated.
records.title: The conformance corpus runs what production runs

records.summary: PM7's projection-pruning mechanism (eligibility predicate, bounded maintenance run, storage-pressure threshold, work_projection_pruned event, archived_work_linked projection) is deferred by decision rather than built: the authority guarantees (git note and domain_events authority, work-ID immutability, link-before-removal, git-rebuildable historical projections, live/historical query union, research cleanup) stand with executable evidence, live projections are accepted as unbounded at pre-floor scale with three recorded revisit triggers, and backup retention and VACUUM stay out of scope under PM10. Deliberate absences (core event pruning, WIP-byte CAS, process-exhaust receipts) stay absent. The PM7 coverage record closes as satisfied.
records.title: PM7 retention amendment — pruning deferred, authority guarantees kept

records.summary: D1 declares worker_packet as a closed object under work_transition_action_input.fields, required for dispatch_worker; D2 binds canonicalJSON+SHA256 of the packet as worker_packet_digest on WorkflowActionCompleted and exposes it on WorkerDispatchWindow via FindAuthorizedDispatchWindowTx, with two identity guards (packet.work_id==action.work_id, packet.attempt_id==fields.attempt_id) refusing closed; D3 adds PayloadObject to the registry value types so the preflight gate enforces object-ness cheaply; D4 accepts reachability for #253 once the lane pipeline installs and a stubbed runner drives dispatch through work_transition; D5 routes dispatch through work_transition.workflow_action with fields.lane_id as tool-level vocabulary the adapter consumes and never forwards, and ships dispatch.ts, packet.ts, lane_dispatch.ts, and generated-agent-lanes.ts in the installed archive; D6 makes the dispatch assertion's packet_digest quote the value the core returned (no adapter-side canonicalJSON coupling) and refuses pre-cutover windows whose recorded digest is empty.
records.title: Dispatch binds the worker packet

records.summary: D1 adds domain_observations keyed (product_id, domain_id) with a foreign key to domains and ON DELETE NO ACTION, reusing the domain attachment-set pattern and carrying the CD-0030 D1 bounds unchanged; D2 caps each Domain at 64 open observations and refuses a full window rather than evicting, because silent eviction is the drop CD-0030 exists to prevent; D3 makes dismissal a two-state flip modeled on work_messages with ApprovalClass required, so the queue is the operator's, while recording stays ApprovalClass none; D4 leaves promotion as the CD-0018 raised_from path, independent of dismissal; D5 preserves CD-0030 non-authority verbatim; D6 folds open observations into concord_domain.detail rather than adding a read operation; D7 puts declared ordering within a Domain out of scope and leaves CD-0041 D8 unrevisited.
records.title: Domain-anchored observations

records.summary: D1 lands the detective layer now: check-durable-tier.py fails in CI on non-markdown artifacts under the note roots, notes over the budget byte bound, fenced JSON blocks over the dump threshold, and uninventoried non-markdown artifacts under docs/decisions, with all bounds single-sourced from docs/durable-tier-budget.v1.json and zero tolerance with no ratchet; D2 sets the bound at 16384 bytes over the compaction-note roots docs/work and docs/lessons, keeps decision records out of the byte bound as a different artifact class, and enforces markdown-only for them through a declared inventory with reasons; D3 records the producer-side strict typed parse as the contract the future compaction pipeline must satisfy, reading the same budget; D4 extends AJ6-compact-terminal-work to assert the compaction path emits an in-budget note; D5 states why three layers: the detective binds every writer at the merge chokepoint, the producer parse catches violations cheapest at write time, and the scenario observes pipeline behavior over time.
records.title: The durable tier is enforced, not advised

records.summary: D1 emits hidden: true in generated lane frontmatter, so a worker lane is not selectable as an operator session agent; D2 preserves CD-0064 D1 mode: all unchanged, because hidden governs operator-facing listing only and run-mode dispatch plus the CD-0064 D2 executor readback are unaffected; D3 records that the registry digest covers the manifest rather than the projected lane body, so no digest and no schema version moves. The exposure was that CD-0017 Invariant 4 governs what a worker does while nothing governed who may become one.
records.title: Lane definitions are hidden from the operator's agent cycle

records.summary: D1 establishes that the authority system's boundary is the model's output stream, not the agent's process, because the seven agent_* tables carry no trigger, the database is same-UID writable, and signing gates issuance only; D2 withdraws the process-level adversary asserted in CD-0044's context and third rejected alternative while leaving its decisions D1-D6 and its verification list binding; D3 accepts absent tamper-evidence on the authority tables as coherent rather than deferred, closing the question CD-0008 left open; D4 divides the system into load-bearing mechanisms (git-derived scope resolution, cross_scope gate, manifest-digest pinning, typed refusals, the approval checkpoint, principal_ref) and non-load-bearing ones (Ed25519 signing, nonce replay, key rotation, grant expiry, use counts) and names issue #465 as the successor for the latter; D5 holds that a process boundary requires a separate UID and a UID-checked socket, which CD-0003 and CD-0042 foreclose; D6 closes the build-a-grant-revoke reading of issue #450, making the three revocation methods removal candidates rather than connection candidates.
records.title: The authority boundary is the model's output, not the agent's process

records.summary: Raw file writes to the trunk checkout through host tooling are deliberately unguarded: the predecessor enforced that half in an editor-host write-interception hook, and no Concord surface can hold such a control because capability-placement section 1 offers no interception point inside another tool's write path. The operator accepted the loss on 2026-08-21 rather than shipping an editor plugin. Grant-level main-checkout refusal, the one-active-worktree-per-Project refusal, and git-fact reclamation remain in force and are not presented as equivalent. The predecessor-coverage record splits its row and cites this decision.
records.title: File-write trunk protection is accepted as unguarded

records.summary: D1 makes the corpus runner fail any scenario whose declared initial_state.fixture_override keys no binding read, so honoring an override and proving it become the same act; D2 fails a binding that reads a key the scenario never declared, guarding the contract in both directions; D3 keeps fixture_override free-form in the schema because closing the key set would have admitted the defect, whose keys were spelled correctly and simply unread; D4 deletes AJ6-compact-terminal-work's two override keys as false rather than implementing them, since compaction_required names no field in the system and canonical_home_project asserts proj-api against a resolver that returns proj-web. AJ5's binding now reads its two keys and checks the fold replay implements what they state.
records.title: A scenario override is honored by its binding or it is not in the corpus

records.summary: D1 puts each project's ready tooling in one hand-authored manifest, .concord/tooling.v1.json, with required tier and independent cadence plus optional bounded cost_hint, config_path, automation_path, and notes; D2 aligns checker and schema text rules through raw string bounds and a required character outside JSON whitespace, validates shape without requiring adopters to vendor Concord's published schema, and proves that the manifest and referenced regular files remain inside the repository across symlinks; D3 holds the CD-0043 D1 boundary by carrying facts about tools and never methodology about when an agent should choose them; D4 performs file reads only so CD-0040 D6's probe-family limit holds and executing repository-named binaries stays unopened; D5 defines routine and on_demand as pure declared cadence intent, keeps automation_path informational, and rejects automation or CI text as cadence proof.
records.title: A project declares its ready tooling as a validated manifest

records.summary: D1 removes cadence from the project tooling schema, checker, tests, and dogfood manifest because routine and on_demand state when an agent should select a command and therefore cross CD-0043 D1's host-owned methodology boundary; the remaining fields describe identity, invocation, cost, and referenced repository files without a selection schedule; D2 replaces an optional jsonschema test, which CI could skip, with direct standard-library comparison of the checker's contract constants against the published schema; D3 changes accepted law by narrowly superseding CD-0074's cadence clauses while preserving its path-containment rules and probe-family exclusion.
records.title: A tooling inventory excludes command-selection cadence

records.summary: Schema 1.2 is the only accepted Concord knowledge manifest shape. The unwired schema 1.0 and 1.1 migration, its transient undecided-root marker, and its compatibility validation branches are removed before launch. This amends CD-0041 D9.2 and CD-0062 D3 while preserving the current root-home rationale and PM1.Q10 projection rules.
records.title: The current knowledge manifest has no legacy migration path

records.summary: Work-item operator kinds and workflow families remain separate vocabularies. Composition resolves the pinned workflow definition. Work kinds and native-run phase/status pairs each have one contract, generated Go projections, literal immutable SQLite registry rows, database triggers, and closure validators that bind all copies.
records.title: Storage vocabularies have one machine-readable authority

records.summary: Terminal placement belongs to the host. No Concord component creates, names, or focuses a multiplexer tab or pane. Launch suspends the launcher in the terminal it was given and restores it when the session exits. Launch is one action; attach is display text, and no session identifier is forwarded because CD-0031 derives continuity from the canonical projection.
records.title: Terminal placement belongs to the host

records.summary: Directory-to-Project resolution becomes a read-only project-resolve CLI verb returning the Project, its owning Products, and the membership scope_version. The verb does not authenticate, because the operator trust boundary is filesystem access to the authority database. It stays off the agent tool surface and appends no event.
records.title: Directory-to-Project resolution is an operator read

records.summary: Authorization becomes the registered client policy intersected with git-derived scope resolved from the invoke envelope on every call. The grant token, the agent_grants table, expiry, and use counts are removed, and host approval keeps its scope, challenge, and consequence bindings without a signature. Worker evidence signing under CD-0067 D6 is out of scope and keeps the client key registry and the nonce table. Approval challenges re-anchor to the session identity tuple, blocked-session Product scope moves to the session record, and the three unbuilt revocation methods are removed. This declines the core-issued opaque session handle CD-0071 D4 anticipated.
records.title: Capability scoping replaces the grant token

records.summary: The closed lane registry becomes research, implement, design, review, verify. The design lane implements visual UI and UX changes for one approved bounded task under implement-matching budgets, and its completions must discharge a new visual_artifacts obligation extended into the CD-0056 closed vocabulary across both schema enums, the Go slice, and the worker-complete CLI spec. The manifest digest moves, the four pre-existing lane digests do not, and model resolution stays with the host under CD-0058.
records.title: The registry gains a design worker lane

records.product_wide_rationale: Keeps migration and correction demand-driven, retains the current replacement-readiness evidence floor, and removes unsupported Product-wide obligations without changing runtime behavior.
records.summary: Migration and correction are demand-driven and ad hoc. Replacement readiness remains an evidence claim. CD-0006 D1-D2 and CD-0053 D4 cutover framing are amended, while Domain, PM4, and data-integrity controls remain bounded and current.
records.title: Migration and replacement controls are demand-driven

records.summary: Assistive-technology validation stops being deferred to a launcher acceptance that already passed. The no-color half of C14 section 9 closes against named render anchors. Screen-reader validation becomes an open operator obligation naming Orca, a procedure, a pass test, and a trigger. A failed run remains a CD-0014 falsifier.
records.title: Assistive-technology validation is an obligation, not a deferral

records.summary: Every Concord tool export returns the ToolResult the host declares. The pinned host reads a string output and splits it without a guard, so returning the raw envelope threw a TypeError and no tool call could succeed. The envelope now travels as JSON text in output as its only carrier, an oversize result becomes a bounded error envelope, the execute boundary drops the concealing any, and the spent TS2322 allowance is removed.
records.title: Concord tool results are host ToolResults

records.summary: The worker-evidence client signing key is held by the OS credential store behind exactly one custody adapter (the secret-tool lookup in adapter/opencode/credentials.ts); the Go core keeps only public keys. The dependency is the freedesktop Secret Service standard, not any provider — gnome-keyring, KWallet, and other implementations are interchangeable without code change, and a platform port swaps the adapter alone. The installer preflight fails closed without a provider, no plaintext fallback exists, and the single-user session-readability residual is recorded rather than hidden.
records.title: Client signing keys live behind a single OS-custody adapter

records.product_wide_rationale: Keeps episode optional for every Concord installation while defining the Product-scoped boundary for operators who configure it.
records.summary: episode remains an optional external authority. Configured integrations are Product-scoped, Concord owns only the formalized promotion destination, and the automatic-scoping probe is a future ownership reopen trigger.
records.title: episode is an optional external authority

records.summary: Credential reads remain provider-independent through the single Secret Service custody adapter, while first-use provisioning may use provider-specific controls. The Linux reference provisioner can create an unencrypted user-scoped gnome-keyring collection, refuses to stop a provider with live items, verifies restricted permissions, and installs automatic unlock after daemon restart.
records.title: Provider-specific provisioning may initialize OS custody

records.summary: One host-owned operation captures or resumes work, reconciles its canonical linked worktree from durable intent, and launches the verified agent there without granting ordinary default-checkout mutation authority. The generic capability does not activate Concord self-hosting before a separate replacement-readiness claim and accepted authority change.
records.title: Host-owned work bootstrap preserves pre-readiness authority

records.product_wide_rationale: Moves Concord development coordination into Concord after the issue #600 bootstrap release while preserving GitHub planning and merge authority, replacement-readiness evidence, and Advance reference-only status.
records.summary: Concord owns its development workflow after issue #600 while GitHub retains planning, review, and merge authority. It supersedes CD-0010's self-hosting prohibition and the equivalent CD-0088 D5 restatement.
records.title: Concord development coordination

records.summary: A per-turn runtime hook in the adapter plugin entry re-asserts the CD-0016 pinned continuity projection after context boundaries, closing the mid-session window where compaction leaves workflow position carried only by a summary. The hook holds no authority: it transports bytes rendered by the sessionboot.Build path, replaces its sentinel-delimited block in place for prompt-cache byte-stability, gates its core spawn by a bounded time window, and degrades to silence on any failure. ContinuitySnapshot gains step_actions as durable-state projection, recorded as agent-tool surface 2.4.0.
records.title: A per-turn runtime continuity hook re-pins orchestrator context

records.product_wide_rationale: Defines the evidence bar that promotes a Product's maturity and audience commitment. It governs how this Product is matured, not how it behaves, so no runtime Domain owns it.
records.summary: Defines the maturity and audience-commitment promotion ladder as evidence claims that reuse the floor-readiness mechanism. Records Concord at prototype and operator_only.
records.title: Maturity and audience-commitment promotion ladder

records.product_wide_rationale: Governs which agent capabilities the main checkout refuses. It is authority law spanning every Domain, so no runtime Domain owns it.
records.summary: Scopes the main-checkout refusal by capability class: work_define resolves from the default checkout because it writes only Product state, while implementation-bearing capabilities stay refused. Amends CD-0072 D2 and CD-0008 D1 at that boundary.
records.title: Main-checkout capability scope

records.product_wide_rationale: Governs what session start resolves before it runs the host. It binds the launcher, the session command, and Project identity together, so no single runtime Domain owns it.
records.summary: Session start resolves the selected work's Project canonical path and uses that one directory for agent resolution, the host registry probe, and execution, failing closed when any of them does not resolve. The host command stays fixed under CD-0078's reasoning, and the per-Project host environment gap is recorded rather than hidden.
records.title: Session start resolves the Project directory

records.product_wide_rationale: Defines operation-scoped main-checkout authority for Product-state lifecycle transitions. It amends the product-wide authority boundary without assigning ownership to a runtime Domain.
records.summary: Allows work_transition.lifecycle from a registered Project's default checkout because it writes one Product-state event, while terminal gates and implementation-bearing refusals remain unchanged.
records.title: Operation-scoped main-checkout authority

records.product_wide_rationale: Amends the product-wide main-checkout authority boundary for one operation without assigning ownership to a runtime Domain.
records.summary: Allows work_transition.worktree_reclaim from a registered Project default checkout when the addressed work item is terminal, because a terminal item holds no live implementation surface. Non-terminal work keeps the CD-0092 refusal.
records.title: Terminal-work main-checkout reclamation

records.product_wide_rationale: Governs the session's persistent worktree target and the product-wide authority tiers for cross-worktree access. It amends session-target authority without assigning ownership to a runtime Domain.
records.summary: Amends CD-0093 D2 so a running session may create or claim its current work item's canonical worktree and persistently retarget later Concord operations to it while the host process directory stays unchanged. Same-Project cross-worktree access is tiered: read-only Inspect, exclusive-lease Verify with unchanged tracked files, typed-transfer Take over, and Destroy limited to merged terminal work or operator approval. Targets derive from registered Project and work identity, possession grants no Product authority, and continuity re-pins the target and lease each turn with stale versions failing closed.
records.title: Allow in-session worktree retargeting under tiered authority

records.product_wide_rationale: Governs cross-system authority, identity, replay, knowledge curation, trusted client policy growth, and cutover for a Product migrating from the predecessor while both systems stay writable. No runtime Domain owns migration authority.
records.summary: Accepts a bounded parallel migration mode for one Product: the operator declares it, the predecessor stays installed, writable, and usable, and it remains the live authority for every migrated surface (specifications, active work, terminal history, wisdom, reflections) until the operator records cutover. Items keep predecessor identity as provenance across repeated harvests, replay applies deterministic effects or idempotent no-ops, conflicts refuse typed naming the owning source, and knowledge curation records every drop. Trusted client policy grows by the additive client-policy-expand command that preserves every existing grant and the stored principal. Cutover changes authority, never installation.
records.title: Allow bounded parallel predecessor migration

records.product_wide_rationale: Governs the single route by which any session acquires an implementation surface, so it binds every Domain rather than one runtime Domain.
records.summary: Amends CD-0096 D6 and CD-0088 D4 at their launch clauses so work start moves the calling session into the claimed worktree instead of launching a new one. The worktree claim is recorded before the move, so a failed move leaves a resumable claim rather than a moved session with no claim. The host move route is required and its absence fails closed with a typed refusal instead of a launch fallback. The default checkout must be clean, the move carries no changes and takes effect from the next turn, and the session directory is read back and verified afterward. The session-prepare directory refusal, lane definition check, and read-back assertion are preserved and now guard the destination of a move.
records.title: Retarget the running session at work start instead of launching one

records.product_wide_rationale: Governs how every worker lane starts and how its authorization binds, across all Domains that dispatch work. It sets an execution boundary rather than owning a runtime Domain.
records.summary: Replaces the child-process worker route with the host's native Task tool, so a dispatched lane renders the standard worker card with progress, navigation, and cancellation. Typed dispatch opens one single-use authorization window; the adapter's before-execute hook refuses a Task call with no open window and otherwise overwrites the caller's agent selection and prompt from the recorded packet, so packet provenance is structural rather than composed by the model. The coordinator posture must order its Task ruleset so a lane pattern is last, because a blanket deny removes the tool from the model request and no hook can reach it. Lanes cannot nest workers, the lane report is the final text part of the worker session, the worker runs where the session runs, and the spawn path is removed with no fallback.
records.title: Run lane dispatch as a native Task under a one-time authorization

records.product_wide_rationale: Corrects the record governing the single route by which any session acquires an implementation surface, so it binds every Domain rather than owning a runtime Domain.
records.summary: Amends CD-0098 D3 at its turn-end clause. The OpenCode move-session route offers no turn, busy, idle, queue, or lock handling, so the retarget takes effect from the next turn because a running turn resolves its paths before the move lands, not because the route waits for a boundary. The behavior is recorded as an observation of host 1.18.26 rather than a guarantee the host provides, and Concord adds no wait or poll of its own. Every other CD-0098 clause is preserved.
records.title: The move route offers no turn boundary, and the record says so

records.product_wide_rationale: Governs which facts Concord may store about a session and its worktree, so it binds every Domain that resolves a tree rather than owning a runtime Domain.
records.summary: A session's worktree is the directory the host reports for it, and Concord stores no copy. The bootstrap launch record and session_worktree_targets are dropped with the retarget, release, and takeover operations, because each was a stored copy of a host fact with no reader outside its own maintenance, and each drifted. work_start replays to convergence on its derived key, so no partial outcome exists. Transient exclusion is resource_busy, coupled to retry_same_request. Amends CD-0096 at Context, D1, D3 Take over, D5, and D6; CD-0088 D4 at the launch record; CD-0098 at the failure contract.
records.title: A session's worktree is its actual directory, and Concord stores no session binding

records.product_wide_rationale: Names the trigger that reclaims a finished worktree, which every Domain that claims a worktree relies on, so it binds Product-wide rather than owning a runtime Domain.
records.summary: The worktree audit reports a fourth drift class, terminal_present: a worktree on disk, still claimed, whose work is completed or cancelled. A typed operation, worktree_audit_reclaim, performs the one safe action the audit names, reclaiming each such row through the direct reclaim's own gates in its own transaction, so one refusal never rolls back another reclamation and a replay returns the recorded pass. Every other class stays report-only. Amends CD-0096 D3 Destroy at the trigger it left unnamed.
records.title: The worktree audit reclaims merged terminal worktrees

records.product_wide_rationale: Removes one tool from every session and fixes the three-rung knowledge ladder that every Domain's lessons and decisions climb, so it binds Product-wide rather than owning a runtime Domain.
records.summary: episode is removed as an external authority and CD-0086 is superseded in full. The knowledge ladder is observation, lesson, decision, and every rung exists today. lesson graduation replaces the episode promotion seam. External-system identity lives in managed_resources and learned usage is a lesson tagged resource:<id>; a record stores a vendor documentation locator, never vendor content. The seven episode rows are exported and migrate to lesson records in their own Product homes.
records.title: lesson owns the knowledge ladder

records.summary: The launcher is remade from zero as the ZLauncher replacement. The core loop is Concord-first browsing with launch actions: a zellij tab on the work's Concord worktree, the OpenCode session started through Concord's session bootstrap, resume, and prompt pass-through as the work directive. The interface is dense panes on arrow, Enter, and Tab keys, still rendered by Bubble Tea v2. The launcher stays store-write-free. ZLauncher is retired when the core loop and the accepted daily extras work on the real store.
records.title: the launcher is the ZLauncher replacement

records.summary: A dispatched lane executes its step as a derived workflow actor, recorded by the dispatch operation from the lane identity, the attempt, and the authenticated host, and pinned by the worker.dispatched fold as the instance's executing actor. accept_worker_result keeps its CD-0013 D5 comparison and now compares the owner against the party that executed, so a completed lane result is acceptable by the owner and by no one the lane identity itself covers. Pre-v4 dispatches replay unchanged and pin no actor.
records.title: the dispatched lane is the step's executing actor

records.product_wide_rationale: Governs the one session route that acquires an implementation worktree, so the origin boundary binds every Domain rather than one runtime Domain.
records.summary: Amends CD-0098 so work_start admits a clean terminal Concord worktree as well as the Project default checkout. The core refuses live, dirty, leased, or dispatched origins before capture, the adapter forwards that refusal, and an empty ref in a linked origin resolves from origin/HEAD. The vacated origin remains for audit reclamation.
records.title: Work start chains from a terminal worktree
